facts.fact: The Fonds de Service Universel des TIC's revised procurement plan for FY2026/27 (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027) lists seven IP-transit connectivity lines for health facilities, secondary schools and community telecentres totalling BIF 11,400,288,125; the document is the fund's plan, published by the finance ministry, not the state budget law.
facts.system: Fonds de Service Universel des TIC (FSU), IP-transit connectivity lines, FY2026/27

facts.fact: The Fonds de Service Universel des TIC, funded by a 1% levy on operators' turnover, is shown paying for projects in its revised FY2026/27 plan: IP-transit connectivity for 25 then 75 public health facilities, 25 then 75 public secondary schools and community telecentres, BIF 11.4 billion in all; the document does not cite the decree that set the fund up.
facts.system: Fonds de Service Universel des TIC (FSU)
